# Relay API reference (version 0.1.0)

<!-- GENERATED by `python -m app.docs_export` from the live OpenAPI document. Do not edit by hand: change the code and regenerate; a test fails when this file is out of date. -->

Every endpoint requires the header `X-API-Key`; a missing or wrong key is 401 `unauthorized`. Errors share one body, `{"error": {"code", "message", "details", "correlation_id"}}`; the codes are in [authentication-and-idempotency.md](authentication-and-idempotency.md). The machine-readable document is [openapi.json](openapi.json).

## `GET /payments`

List payments, newest first

Keyset pagination on `(created_at, id)` descending. Pass `next_cursor` as `cursor` for the next page; it is null on the last page.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | query | no | array of one of `received`, `routed`, `authorized`, `captured`, `declined`, `failed` or `null` |  |
| `processor` | query | no | one of `A`, `B` or `null` |  |
| `is_final` | query | no | `boolean` or `null` |  |
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` (min 1, max 100) |  |
| `cursor` | query | no | `string` or `null` | The opaque `next_cursor` of the previous page |

Responses:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Successful Response | `PaymentListResponse` |
| 400 | Error `malformed_request` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 401 | Error `unauthorized` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 422 | Error `validation_failed` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 500 | Error `internal_error` | `ErrorResponse` |

## `POST /payments`

Create a payment

Creates a payment in `received`. A repeat with the same Idempotency-Key and body returns the stored first response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Without `Idempotency-Key` the answer is 400 `idempotency_key_missing`.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | yes | `string` (min length 1, max length 255) | 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters |

Request body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `amount_minor` | `integer` (min 1, max 1000000000000) | yes |
| `currency` | one of `USD`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `JPY` | yes |
| `description` | `string` (max length 200) or `null` | no |
| `reference` | `string` (pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$`) or `null` | no |

Responses:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 201 | Created, or a replay of the first response | `PaymentResponse` |
| 400 | Error `idempotency_key_missing` or `malformed_request` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 401 | Error `unauthorized` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 409 | Error `idempotency_key_reused` or `idempotency_request_in_progress` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 422 | Error `validation_failed` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 500 | Error `internal_error` | `ErrorResponse` |

## `GET /payments/{payment_id}/explanation`

Get the latest explanation of a final payment

Returns the latest stored explanation, labelled with its source (`model` or `rules`). A final payment without one gets one generated and stored with `trigger=on_request`. 404 for an unknown payment, 409 `payment_not_final` while it is still processing or retrying.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `payment_id` | path | yes | `string` |  |

Responses:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Successful Response | `ExplanationResponse` |
| 401 | Error `unauthorized` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 404 | Error `not_found` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 409 | Error `payment_not_final` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 500 | Error `internal_error` | `ErrorResponse` |

## `POST /payments/{payment_id}/explanation/regenerate`

Generate a new explanation of a final payment now

Stores a new explanation with `trigger=regenerate` and returns it. 404 for an unknown payment, 409 `payment_not_final` for a payment that is not final.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `payment_id` | path | yes | `string` |  |

Responses:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 201 | Successful Response | `ExplanationResponse` |
| 401 | Error `unauthorized` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 404 | Error `not_found` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 409 | Error `payment_not_final` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 500 | Error `internal_error` | `ErrorResponse` |

## `GET /analytics`

Volume, success rate, latency and failure reasons by processor

Figures for payments created in [`from`, `to`) (default: the last 24 hours; at most 31 days), optionally only payments routed to one `processor`. Derived from `payment_events`; money and the handling processor are joined from `payments`.

## `POST /webhooks/subscriptions`

Register a webhook subscription

`url` must be http or https to a host in `WEBHOOK_ALLOWED_HOSTS`, otherwise 422 `webhook_target_not_allowed` and nothing is fetched or stored. `event_types` are payment lifecycle types only. The response carries the signing `secret`, generated by Relay; it is returned only here and never again.

Request body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `url` | `string` (min length 1, max length 2048) | yes |
| `event_types` | array of one of `payment.received`, `payment.authorized`, `payment.captured`, `payment.declined`, `payment.failed`, `payment.final` | yes |

Responses:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 201 | Successful Response | `SubscriptionCreated` |
| 400 | Error `malformed_request` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 401 | Error `unauthorized` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 422 | Error `validation_failed` or `webhook_target_not_allowed` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 500 | Error `internal_error` | `ErrorResponse` |

## `GET /webhooks/deliveries`

The delivery log, newest first

One entry per delivery (one event to one subscription) with its attempt count, status and the last response (`last_status_code`, or `last_error` for a timeout or connection error). Keyset pagination on `(created_at, id)` descending, like `GET /payments`: pass `next_cursor` as `cursor` for the next page; it is null on the last page. `limit` is the page size (1 to 100); the filters apply to every page. A malformed `cursor` is 400 `malformed_request`. Rows are kept for `WEBHOOK_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS` after they are delivered or failed.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `subscription_id` | query | no | `string` or `null` |  |
| `status` | query | no | one of `pending`, `delivered`, `failed` or `null` |  |
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` (min 1, max 100) |  |
| `cursor` | query | no | `string` or `null` | The opaque `next_cursor` of the previous page |

Responses:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Successful Response | `DeliveryListResponse` |
| 400 | Error `malformed_request` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 401 | Error `unauthorized` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 422 | Error `validation_failed` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 500 | Error `internal_error` | `ErrorResponse` |

## `GET /webhooks/deliveries/summary`

Webhook delivery success rate

Counts of `delivered`, `failed` and `pending` deliveries in the window [`since`, `until`) and `success_rate` = delivered / (delivered + failed), null when no delivery is final. A delivered or failed delivery falls in the window by its `updated_at` (when it finished), a pending one by its `created_at`. `since` and `until` are ISO 8601 (a time without a zone is UTC) and optional; `subscription_id` limits the count to one subscription. Computed from the delivery log, so rows past `WEBHOOK_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS` are gone.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `since` | query | no | `string` or `null` |  |
| `until` | query | no | `string` or `null` |  |
| `subscription_id` | query | no | `string` or `null` |  |

Responses:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Successful Response | `DeliverySummaryResponse` |
| 401 | Error `unauthorized` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 422 | Error `validation_failed` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 500 | Error `internal_error` | `ErrorResponse` |

## `GET /webhooks/deliveries/{delivery_id}`

One delivery with every attempt

The delivery plus `attempts`, in order: for each attempt its number, the HTTP `status_code` (null without a response), `error` (the same values as `last_error`), `duration_ms` and `attempted_at`. Attempts are deleted with their delivery by the retention cleanup. An unknown id is 404.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `delivery_id` | path | yes | `integer` |  |

Responses:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Successful Response | `DeliveryDetailResponse` |
| 401 | Error `unauthorized` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 404 | Error `not_found` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 422 | Error `validation_failed` | `ErrorResponse` |
| 500 | Error `internal_error` | `ErrorResponse` |
